name: Advanced Berry Breeding B.V.
description: Dutch berry breeding company founded in 2006 and acquired by Planasa. Its published variety list and its owner's description of it cover raspberry only: Zawadi, Sarafina, Rafiki, Baridi, Shani, Malaika and Kwanza. Licenses Malaika and Zawadi to The Summer Berry Company (TSBC) for Portugal under its tiered Elite Raspberry Collection (ERC) platform -- TSBC is the first Portuguese grower to hold ERC's Gold License. No blueberry cultivar, patent or plant breeders' right attributable to this company was found, so it is recorded here as a group member with no identified blueberry activity.

attributes.leadership: CEO Hubert Gadret; CSO Roy Briga
attributes.managed_variety_platform: Elite Raspberry Collection (ERC) Membership Program, tiered Bronze/Silver/Gold (raspberry, not blueberry)
